verdict.rationale: Daytona's core product is isolated sandboxes, each with a dedicated kernel, filesystem, network stack and resources. Snapshots give reproducible environments, executions can start from a clean state, and per-sandbox firewalls restrict outbound access to prevent exfiltration. Together these let an agent test code in a sealed environment away from production systems. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees, and explicit guidance on keeping production data and credentials separate or seeding test data.
